description: This file defines a Page Object Model class for the Chart Creation page in a web application, used for automated testing with Playwright. It includes methods to interact with page elements such as dataset selector, visualization gallery, and create chart button.

classes.name: ChartCreationPage
classes.description: A page object representing the chart creation wizard page, providing methods to interact with UI elements for automated testing.

methods.name: getDatasetSelectContainer
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the dataset selector container, which includes the displayed selection value.

methods.name: getDatasetSelect
methods.description: Returns a Select object for interacting with the dataset dropdown.

methods.name: getVizGallery
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the visualization gallery container.

methods.name: getCreateChartButton
methods.description: Returns the Button object for the 'Create new chart' button.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates the browser to the chart creation page.

methods.name: waitForPageLoad
methods.description: Waits until the dataset selector is visible, indicating the page has loaded.

methods.name: selectDataset
methods.description: Selects a dataset from the dropdown by name.

methods.name: selectVizType
methods.description: Selects a visualization type from the gallery by name.

methods.name: clickCreateNewChart
methods.description: Clicks the button to proceed to chart exploration.

methods.name: expectDatasetSelected
methods.description: Verifies that a specific dataset is currently selected.

methods.name: isCreateButtonEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the 'Create new chart' button is enabled.
